items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717133/88bd6a284507af472703bb89d608a6e5ee3e1ab9.png"]Dear Thaumaturges,

Do you wish you could skip combat in The Thaumaturge? The solution to all your worries is here! We are introducing an auto-battler. From now on, the lowest difficulty setting allows you to automatically win a fight.
Patch 1.2
Improved Story mode
Improved Story mode (the easiest difficulty setting) allows you to automatically win a fight. Using this option decreases the amount of XP received.
Please note that auto-battler isn’t available in the first tutorial fights.
Rendering improvements
Optimized engine algorithm to reduce rendering work related to crowd characters.
Upgraded Intel XeSS upscaler from version 1.4.7 to 3.0.1.2. This improves visual clarity of an upscaled image.
Story fixes
Fixed the Upyr vision in the Memory Horizon quest not working correctly after loading a specific autosave.
Fixed an occasional crash while failing the Upyr vision in the Memory Horizon quest.
Added a new checkpoint in Close to the Apple Tree quest to prevent a very rare progression blocker that prevented a player from completing the “Talk to Burnakovich” objective.
Take care,
Fool's Theory and 11 bit studios

Hello everyone,

The latest Patch for The Thaumaturge is out now. The main focus was improving the game's performance and we're glad to announce that with this update the minimum requirements have been lowered. You can check them here.
Aside from all the updates listed below, the patch also introduces an in-game newsfeed. We promise no-spam and only relevant non-intrusive updates!
Major optimization changes to improve performance. In addition Minimum System Requirements has been lowered on GPU side of things to better reflect the current state of the performance;
More improvements to overall stability that should reduce instances of random crashes.
Fixed the issue with abrupt lighting change during one of the generic combat encounters;
Fixed the issue with missing prompt for the "No" action if leaving to main menu after the game was unfocused while in combat;
Credits has been updated;
Navigation with a D-Pad in Options has been added as a quality of life improvement;
Fixed instances of missing translations;
Improvements for animations and clipping issues across multiple scenes;
UI improvements;
Navigation improvements;
Collision improvements.
Fixed the issue where completing Vision of Upyr quests could break collision of certain objects in interiors;
Fixed the issue where it was impossible to remove one of the NPC's flaw if certain objective was done after another one during They're Alive side quest;
Fixed the issue where desert vision was affected by the time of day during Fearless side quest;
Fixed the issue where certain objects were hovering mid-air in headquarters interior during They're Alive side quest;
Fixed the issue with corrupted animations and missing scene shots if Deed manipulation was chosen during the end of Bastards of the Night main quest;
Fixed the issue where one of the NPCs was blurry during a scene during In the Abyss main quest.
Take care,
Fool's Theory and 11 bit studios

items.text: Hello everyone!

items.text: Hello everyone!
We have just released a patch for the demo. Hope it will improve your overall experience :)
Fixed instances where the game crashed when playing on Nvidia graphics cards;
Fixed the issue where completing the quest in a specific order did not unlock Wise Woman's path despite having collected all the required clues and conclusions;
Fixed the issue where Upyr spawned near Coachman when manipulation was not active anymore;
Tweaks to different animations;
Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Please share your demo feedback with us using the form below.

items.text: It will be a great support and we'll appreciate it dearly!
➡️PLEASE SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK HERE⬅️

Also, for those of you who intend on giving the demo a try, here's a list of current issues that we're aware of and intend to fix before the release. Please, keep those in mind when reviewing your experience :)
Key Rebinding: We are aware that the demo version lacks a possibility to rebind keys to your own needs. It will be possible in the final release of the game.
Visible hitches while loading a save file: We are aware of this issue, it will be resolved in the final release of the game.

Settings: Some settings available in the Options menu might have a slight or seemingly no effect on desired change or can be reset after restarting the game, we are aware of it, tweaks will be done and everything will be operational in the final release of the game.

Gamepad Controller: It is possible to experience The Thaumaturge on gamepad controller, however singular cases of gamepad controls might not be operational, i.e singular button in the Conclusions sub-menu, in such cases please use either mouse or keyboard. Those singular issues will be resolved in the final release of the game.
Twisted hands: Rarely you might encounter twisted arms during the dialogues. This issue will be resolved in the final release of the game.
Optimization: We are still heavily working on optimization and this work will be continued until the final release of the game.
Add The Thaumaturge to your wishlist and don't miss any future updates:
Take care,
Fool's Theory and 11 bit studios
